items.item: There is no greeting or hero; the header has a title and a date-range control
items.evidence: Page header is h1 'Operations dashboard' plus select#range (Today / Yesterday / Last 7 days) with #range-dates; no greeting or hero anywhere.

items.item: Each KPI tile shows label, value and a signed change with its comparison period, without decorative icon tiles
items.evidence: renderKpis emits label (text-xs), value (text-2xl tabular-nums) and fmtDelta(k, r.vs), e.g. '+8% vs yesterday', '−0.4 h vs yesterday', '+0.2 pts vs yesterday'. No icons, no pills.

items.item: Charts use bars for comparison and lines for trends; no pie, donut or gauge; axes have labels and units
items.evidence: lineChart(): Today vs Yesterday lines, x-axis 'Hour of day', y-axis 'Units picked per hour'. renderZones(): horizontal bars with x-axis title 'Open pick tasks (count)' and zone category labels. No pie, donut or gauge.

items.item: A needs-attention list links to pre-filtered list pages
items.evidence: #w-attn ATTN items are anchors: shipments.html?status=late, receiving.html?status=waiting&wait=gt2h, pick-tasks.html?zone=A&assignee=none, cycle-counts.html?status=mismatch, stock.html?filter=below-reorder.

items.item: Numbers use locale formatting and tabular figures
items.evidence: Intl.NumberFormat('en-GB') used throughout (shows 1,284; 99.4%; compact 1.5k); tabular-nums on KPI values, deltas, table cells and range dates; audit tabular-nums nonTabular=0, misaligned=0.

items.item: Each widget has loading and empty states
items.evidence: All five renderers (renderAttn, renderKpis, renderTrend, renderZones, renderLate) handle 'loading' (animate-pulse skeletons) and 'empty' (e.g. 'No picks recorded in this range.', 'No late shipments in this range.'); #demo select exercises the empty state; error with Retry also present.

notes: Clean, restrained admin UI with no template tells found. Status badges are only red/amber, which is semantic and not a rainbow. The LH avatar is a person's initials. Minor observations: the audit flags table-above-fold (late shipments table at 923px, warn) because the dashboard puts attention list and KPIs above it, which is acceptable for a dashboard; KPI deltas are not coloured good or bad, so direction carries no semantic cue; bar axis ticks are fractional (37.5, 112.5, 150) while max data is 118; the Needs attention list repeats the word 'Needs attention' as a badge under a section of that name; a demo-state control is left in the page footer.
